exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb てくれませんか".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞てくれませんか matches "Verb てくれませんか".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞てくれませんか.
exercises.explanation: Polite way to request someone to do something for you.
